newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RALLYING-MCRAE AND SAINZ SHARE OPENING STAGE.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-MCRAE AND SAINZ SHARE OPENING STAGE.

text.p: Briton Colin McRae and Spaniard Carlos Sainz shared the lead in the Portuguese Rally on Sunday after the opening special stage.
Both drivers clocked one minute one second on a speed test prologue reduced from 3.7 km to 1.7 km after some drivers claimed the full course was dangerous.
Subaru driver McRae leads the world championship after three rounds. Sainz, a former title-holder like the Scot, was in a Ford.
Five drivers finished a second behind, including Briton Richard Burns in only his second appearance this year for the Mitsubishi team.
Reigning world champion Tommi Makinen of Finland suffered a brake failure in his Mitsubishi Lancer and will start on Monday down the field.
